response.original_title: Berryz Kobo Kessei 7 Shuunen Kinen Concert Tour 2011 Haru ~Shuukan Berryz Times~
response.overview: Berryz Kobo Kessei 7 Shuunen Kinen Concert Tour 2011 Haru ~Shuukan Berryz Times~ is the twenty-seventh DVD released by Berryz Kobo. It features footage from their spring 2011 concert tour on May 3, 2011 at Nakano Sunplaza. This concert tour marked the seventh year anniversary for the group. The DVD reached #27 on the Oricon charts and charted for two weeks.
